title: Broken Letters, Broken Narratives: A Case Study on Arabic Script in DALL-E 3

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing generated images and DALL-E 3's automatically revised prompts for Orientalist stereotypes, specifically tracking the unprompted addition of terms conveying antiquity (e.g., 'ancient', 'traditional') and religious motifs (e.g., mosques) when generating Arabic script.

Evaluating the formal correctness and structural fidelity of generated text by prompting the model with single letters, high-frequency words, and specific calligraphic styles in Farsi and Arabic, and contrasting the failure to render these scripts with the model's ability to accurately render Latin text.
